entry.title: New: Bill 64 (2025) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 5659, BILL NO. 62, CD1 (2024), RELATING TO THE ISSUANCE OF GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS OF THE COUNTY OF MAUI ISSUANCE, SALE AND DELIVERY OF SAID BONDS (DEPARTMENT OF MANAGEMENT)" The purpose of this bill is to add a new appropriation for acquisition of 105 North Market Street, Wailuku, in the amount of $3,250,000.
